tldr: **台股盤中震盪逾千點，終場小跌至 43,360.66 點，台積電下挫 2.11%。**
**金管會核准台新銀併新光銀，合併後總資產約 4.7 兆元、分行數躍居國銀第二。**
**華爾街改寫新高，標普與道瓊創歷史新高、那斯達克漲 2.59%，中東緊張緩解帶動漲勢。**
**油價跌破 80 美元，市場憧憬美伊達成重啟荷莫茲海峽協議。**
**美國對台 20% 對等關稅 8/7 生效，台灣備妥 880 億元支持方案因應。**

items.title_en: TAIEX closes near flat at 43,360.66 after a 1,000-point intraday swing (2026-08-04)
items.summary_zh: 加權指數週二終場僅跌 25.75 點、跌幅 0.06%，收在 43,360.66 點，但平淡收盤掩蓋劇烈震盪：盤中一度跌破 43,000 點，隨後反彈至 43,912.77 點高點，振幅逾千點，成交量約 1.04 兆元。盤面並非全面殺盤，而是強烈的類股輪動，指數表面持穩、資金於檯面下換手。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index ended Tuesday down just 25.75 points, or 0.06%, at 43,360.66, but the calm close masked a wild session: the index briefly broke below 43,000 before rallying to an intraday high of 43,912.77, a swing of more than 1,000 points, on turnover of about NT$1.04 trillion. Rather than broad selling, trading reflected heavy sector rotation, leaving the headline index steady while flows shifted beneath the surface.

items.title_en: TSMC falls 2.11% to NT$2,320, shedding NT$1.3tn in market value (2026-08-04)
items.summary_zh: 台積電下跌 50 元、跌幅 2.11%，收在 2,320 元，為當日市值減損最多個股，市值降至約 60.16 兆元。作為權值王，台積電走弱是拖累大盤主因；但因資金轉進記憶體、CPO 與 AI 伺服器族群，大盤仍守穩，市場情緒未因權值股回檔而全面轉弱。
items.summary_en: Taiwan Semiconductor dropped NT$50, or 2.11%, to close at NT$2,320, recording the single largest market-cap loss of the session and ending the day valued at about NT$60.16 trillion. As the index's dominant weighting, TSMC's slide was the main drag on the TAIEX, yet the broader market held up as investors rotated into memory, co-packaged optics and AI-server names, keeping overall sentiment resilient despite the chip giant's pullback.

items.title_zh: 資金輪動記憶體、CPO 與 AI 伺服器供應鏈（2026-08-04）
items.title_en: Investors rotate into memory, CPO and AI-server supply chains (2026-08-04)
items.summary_zh: 台積電承壓之際，買盤週二轉向更廣的 AI 硬體族群，青睞基本面與訂單能見度較佳的記憶體、共同封裝光學（CPO）與 AI 伺服器組裝廠。此輪動顯示台灣科技優勢正由先進製程晶圓代工，向高頻寬記憶體與光互連擴散，使 AI 建置紅利擴及更廣的零組件與系統生態圈。
items.summary_en: With TSMC under pressure, buying spread across the broader AI hardware complex on Tuesday, favouring memory makers, co-packaged optics (CPO) suppliers and AI-server assemblers seen as having strong fundamentals and order visibility. The rotation underscores how Taiwan's tech leadership is broadening beyond leading-edge foundry into high-bandwidth memory and optical interconnect, spreading the benefits of the AI build-out across a wider slice of the island's component and systems ecosystem.

items.title_zh: 台達電撐盤、抵銷權值股拖累（2026-08-04）
items.title_en: Delta Electronics helps cushion the index as heavyweights wobble (2026-08-04)
items.summary_zh: 電源與零組件大廠台達電於週二震盪盤中明顯撐盤，抵銷部分台積電等大型科技股的下拉力道。台達電走強反映 AI 資料中心與伺服器建置帶動的電源與散熱需求穩健，使其成為今年推升台灣硬體供應鏈之基礎建設投資的主要受惠者之一。
items.summary_en: Component and power-management maker Delta Electronics provided notable support to the TAIEX during Tuesday's volatile session, offsetting part of the drag from TSMC and other large-cap tech names. Delta's strength reflects steady demand for power and thermal solutions tied to AI data-centre and server build-outs, positioning it as a key beneficiary of the same infrastructure spending that is powering Taiwan's broader hardware supply chain this year.

items.title_zh: 金管會核准台新銀併新光銀、打造 4.7 兆元大行（2026-08-04）
items.title_en: FSC approves Taishin–Shin Kong bank merger, creating NT$4.7tn lender (2026-08-04)
items.summary_zh: 金管會核准台新銀行合併新光銀行，合併基準日暫定 2027 年 1 月 1 日，以台新銀行為存續銀行。合併後總資產約 4.7 兆元、資本額約 1,703 億元，為國內第七大銀行；國內 204 家分行數僅次於合庫、居國銀第二。金管會並要求須確保核心系統穩定切換與客戶交易不中斷。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission cleared Taishin International Bank's absorption of Shin Kong Bank, with a tentative effective date of Jan 1, 2027 and Taishin as the surviving entity. The combined bank will hold about NT$4.7 trillion in assets and roughly NT$170.3 billion in capital, ranking as Taiwan's seventh-largest bank, while its 204 domestic branches will trail only Taiwan Cooperative Bank. Regulators stressed that core-system integration must ensure a stable switchover and uninterrupted customer transactions.

items.title_zh: 金管會預告修正保險業財報編製準則（2026-08-04）
items.title_en: FSC pre-announces amendments to insurers' financial reporting rules (2026-08-04)
items.summary_zh: 金管會預告修正保險業財務報告編製準則，配合 IFRS 17 與新清償能力制度上路，優化財報之表達與揭露。此舉旨在強化保險業資產負債與準備金揭露透明度，在業者調適公允價值會計與更高資本標準之際，讓投資人與保戶更清楚掌握其財務體質。
items.summary_en: The commission issued a draft revision to the guidelines governing insurers' financial statements, aiming to improve the presentation and disclosure of their reports as the sector operates under IFRS 17 and the new solvency regime. The changes are intended to sharpen transparency around insurers' balance sheets and reserves, giving investors and policyholders a clearer view of financial health at a time when the industry is adjusting to fair-value accounting and higher capital standards.

items.title_zh: 銀行高資產「財管 2.0」規模成長 2.7 倍至 2.7 兆元
items.title_en: Banks' high-asset "Wealth Management 2.0" AUM grows 2.7x to NT$2.7tn
items.summary_zh: 在亞洲資產管理中心政策推動下，銀行高資產業務管理資產已成長 2.7 倍至約 2.7 兆元，截至 2026 年 5 月服務約 2.5 萬名客戶；政策上路以來全業 AUM 增逾 10 兆元，超過兩年目標的兩倍。快速擴張顯示國銀爭搶超高資產客群競爭加劇，並強化台北打造區域財富管理中心之企圖。
items.summary_en: Under Taiwan's Asia Asset Management Center push, banks' high-net-worth business has expanded 2.7-fold to about NT$2.7 trillion in assets under management, serving some 25,000 clients as of May 2026, while industry-wide AUM has risen more than NT$10 trillion since the policy launched — over double its two-year target. The rapid build-out signals intensifying competition among domestic banks for ultra-high-net-worth clients and reinforces Taipei's ambition as a regional wealth hub.

items.title_zh: 家族辦公室與另類資產成超高資產客群焦點
items.title_en: Family offices and alternative assets take centre stage for UHNW clients
items.summary_zh: 近期業界報告與論壇指出，台灣超高資產家族正轉向家族辦公室、私募與另類資產配置，以及跨境稅務與傳承規劃。銀行由單一商品銷售轉向以整體財富「資產池」融資與治理為核心的整合式顧問，並推出未指定受益人信託等創新。此趨勢重塑私銀競爭樣貌，強調家族價值延續與長期架構規劃，而非交易型商品銷售。
items.summary_en: Recent industry reports and forums highlight a shift among Taiwan's ultra-high-net-worth families toward family offices, private-market and alternative-asset allocations, and cross-border tax and succession planning. Banks are moving from single-product selling to integrated advisory built around whole-of-wealth "asset pool" financing and governance, with innovations such as unspecified-beneficiary trusts. The trend reshapes how private banks compete, emphasising continuity of family values and long-horizon structuring over transactional product sales.

items.title_zh: 2026 遺贈稅課稅級距拉寬、免稅額維持不變
items.title_en: 2026 estate and gift tax brackets widened as cumulative CPI tops 10%
items.summary_zh: 財政部因級距自 2017 年調整後累計物價漲幅超過 10% 的指數化門檻，將 2026 年遺產稅與贈與稅課稅級距金額拉寬。惟免稅額與各項扣除額維持不變，因 2025 年 CPI 未達自 2022 年調整以來的 10% 觸發門檻。此「級距升、免稅額平」的結果減輕大額遺贈稅負，也讓年底公告成為規劃關鍵時點。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Ministry of Finance widened the estate and gift tax brackets for 2026 after cumulative inflation since the brackets were last set in 2017 exceeded the 10% indexation threshold, pushing the thresholds higher. Core exemptions and deductions, however, were left unchanged because 2025 CPI did not clear the 10% trigger from their last 2022 adjustment. The split outcome eases the effective burden on large estates and gifts while keeping the year-end announcement a key date for planners.
items.source_name: TICPA 台北市會計師公會

items.title_zh: 贈與稅級距拉寬、10% 稅率區間多出約 311 萬元贈與空間
items.title_en: Widened gift-tax brackets add about NT$3.11m of lower-rate annual gifting room
items.summary_zh: 級距金額調升後，高資產家庭於每年較低稅率區間內可移轉更多資產：實務估算 2026 年新制使 10% 邊際稅率區間內約可多贈與 311 萬元始跳升稅率；每人每年贈與免稅額仍為 244 萬元。此調整使 2026 年成為依新門檻檢視多年期贈與計畫與傳承架構的自然時點。
items.summary_en: With the brackets pushed higher, wealthy families can transfer more within each year's lower-rate band: practitioners estimate the 2026 change allows roughly an extra NT$3.11 million to be gifted inside the 10% marginal band before hitting higher rates. The exemption itself stays at NT$2.44 million per donor per year. The adjustment makes 2026 a natural checkpoint to revisit multi-year gifting schedules and succession structures around the new thresholds.

items.title_zh: 美國對台 20% 對等關稅 8/7 生效，台灣備妥 880 億元支持方案
items.title_en: US 20% reciprocal tariff on Taiwan takes effect Aug 7; Taipei readies NT$88bn support
items.summary_zh: 美方調整後對台商品之暫時性「對等」關稅 20%，將於美東時間 8 月 7 日（台灣時間 8/7 中午）、即行政命令發布七日後生效。政府隨即端出「9 大面向、20 項措施、總經費約 880 億元」的出口供應鏈支持方案，協助企業、勞工與農漁民減緩關稅衝擊。
items.summary_en: Washington's adjusted temporary "reciprocal" tariff of 20% on Taiwanese goods is set to take effect on Aug 7 (US Eastern time, noon Aug 7 Taiwan time), seven days after the executive order was announced. In response, Taiwan's government has rolled out an export-supply-chain support package spanning nine areas and 20 measures with total funding of about NT$88 billion to cushion firms, workers and farmers from the tariff hit.

items.title_zh: 對美貿易順差持續帶來新台幣升值壓力
items.title_en: Trade surplus with the US keeps appreciation pressure on the NT dollar
items.summary_zh: 分析指出，台灣對美龐大貿易順差持續推升新台幣升值壓力，使央行傳統「阻升不阻貶」策略難以延續。在 AI 晶片與高效能運算帶動出口強勁下，央行被認為將轉向避免匯率過度波動、而非積極阻升，此轉變對高度依賴出口的製造業獲利帶來影響。
items.summary_en: Analysts note that Taiwan's large trade surplus with the United States continues to fuel appreciation pressure on the New Taiwan dollar, complicating the central bank's traditional "resist rises, not falls" stance. With export strength led by AI chips and high-performance computing, the CBC is seen leaning toward smoothing excessive volatility rather than actively capping gains, a shift that carries margin implications for the island's export-reliant manufacturers.

items.title_zh: 中東緊張緩解、全球風險偏好回升
items.title_en: Global risk appetite rebounds as Middle East tensions ease
items.summary_zh: 美伊可能達成重啟荷莫茲海峽協議的預期升溫，帶動油價走低、股市改寫新高，全球市場情緒轉佳。對台灣而言，油價回落可緩解輸入性通膨壓力，避險轉為偏多亦支撐以出口與科技為主的台股；惟談判尚未定案，在密集數據公布前，消息面風險仍高。
items.summary_en: Sentiment across global markets brightened as hopes grew for a US–Iran deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, sending crude lower and lifting equities to fresh highs. For Taiwan, cheaper oil eases imported-inflation pressure and the risk-on tone supports its export- and tech-heavy market, though the still-unresolved talks keep headline risk elevated heading into a data-heavy stretch.

items.title_zh: 官員稱利率已足夠、市場預期 Fed 按兵不動
items.title_en: Fed seen holding as officials call current rates sufficient
items.summary_zh: 聯準會官員表示目前利率水準已足以引導通膨回到目標，強化 Fed 短期維持不動的預期。利率持穩、美元偏強的環境，仍是牽動利率敏感的台股與資金流入亞洲市場的關鍵變數，投資人續聚焦即將公布的美國就業與通膨數據。
items.summary_en: Comments from Federal Reserve officials that current interest-rate levels are enough to steer inflation back toward target have reinforced expectations that the Fed will stay on hold near term. A steady-rate, firm-dollar backdrop remains a key swing factor for Taiwan's rate-sensitive equities and for capital flows into Asian markets, keeping investors focused on upcoming US labour and inflation data.

items.title_zh: 美股改寫新高、科技股反彈（2026-08-04）
items.title_en: US stocks hit record highs as tech rebounds (2026-08-04)
items.summary_zh: 華爾街週二勁揚，標普 500 上漲約 1.79% 至 7,737 點創新高，道瓊大漲約 907 點、漲幅 1.71%，收在約 54,086 點的歷史高點，那斯達克大漲約 2.59% 至 26,585 點。中東緊張緩解、油價下跌與強勁財報共同推升漲勢。
items.summary_en: Wall Street rallied on Tuesday, with the S&P 500 climbing about 1.79% to a record 7,737 and the Dow surging roughly 907 points, or 1.71%, to an all-time high near 54,086, while the Nasdaq jumped about 2.59% to 26,585. Easing Middle East tensions, falling oil and strong earnings powered the advance.

items.title_zh: 油價跌破 80 美元、憧憬美伊重啟荷莫茲協議（2026-08-03）
items.title_en: Oil slides below $80 on US–Iran deal hopes to reopen Hormuz (2026-08-03)
items.summary_zh: 原油重挫，布蘭特原油跌逾 4%、跌破每桶 80 美元，因美方釋出可能達成重啟荷莫茲海峽協議的訊號。美國財長貝森特稱一兩日內或有協議，惟伊朗否認正進行直接談判。
items.summary_en: Crude fell sharply, with Brent dropping more than 4% below $80 a barrel, after US officials signalled a possible deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said an agreement could come within a day or two, though Iran denied that direct talks were under way.

items.title_zh: Palantir 財報亮眼、股價飆約 29%（2026-08-04）
items.title_en: Palantir soars about 29% on blowout earnings (2026-08-04)
items.summary_zh: AI 軟體公司 Palantir 公布優於預期財報後股價飆漲約 29%，帶動資訊科技類股上漲約 4%，助攻大盤收在新高。此走勢凸顯投資人對 AI 概念股的持續偏好，即便對偏高估值仍有戒心。
items.summary_en: Shares of AI-software firm Palantir Technologies surged roughly 29% after reporting better-than-expected results, lifting the information-technology sector about 4% and helping drive the broad market's record close. The move underscored investors' continued appetite for AI-linked names even amid caution over stretched valuations.

items.title_zh: 費城 Fed 主席 Paulson 稱現行利率已足夠（2026-08-04）
items.title_en: Fed's Paulson says current rate level is sufficient (2026-08-04)
items.summary_zh: 費城聯準銀行總裁 Anna Paulson 週二表示，她認為目前利率水準已足以使通膨持續朝央行 2% 目標邁進，此番談話強化市場對短期按兵不動的預期。在投資人等待一連串美國就業與通膨數據之際，此言有助穩定利率預期。
items.summary_en: Philadelphia Federal Reserve President Anna Paulson said Tuesday that she views the current level of interest rates as sufficient to keep inflation moving toward the central bank's 2% goal, comments that reinforced market expectations for a near-term hold. The remarks helped steady rate expectations as investors awaited a run of key US labour and inflation data.
